question: The first Education Policy in India was announced in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1968**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first Education Policy of India** was announced in the year **1968 by then Prime Minister Smt. Indira Gandhi.**
 
• The first Education Policy in India was based on the reports of the **Kothari Commission 1964-1966. **
 
• The** policy included compulsory education for all children up to the age of 14.**​
 
• The language formula was introduced in secondary education which emphasized on learning of regional languages.
 
• Learning of the Sanskrit language is also promoted in this scheme.
 
• **Triguna Sen **was the **Education Minister of India **at that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Second Education policy **was announced in **1986 by then Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi**.
 
• The **Third Education Policy** (currently applicable) was introduced on **29 July 2020** by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
